report.summary: Found 4 issues: (1) routing_summary may recommend unavailable lane; (2) get_queue crashes on concurrent file access; (3) _safe_collect_status may propagate unexpected exceptions; (4) documentation guarantee missing in _safe_load_project. Addressed specific triggers for each.

risks.description: routing_summary ignores Claude health when Ollama server is ready, recommending 'claude' lane even if Claude CLI is unavailable.
risks.trigger: Project with default_lane='claude', Ollama server ready, Claude CLI not on PATH.

risks.description: get_queue -> _file_item raises unhandled OSError (e.g., PermissionError on Windows) when a file is deleted/locked between glob and stat, crashing the dashboard.
risks.trigger: Watcher writes a file to OUTBOX/INBOX concurrently; dashboard reads and stat fails because file already moved/locked.

risks.description: _safe_collect_status docstrings says 'Degrade on any of these' but only catches OSError, SubprocessError, ValueError; other exceptions (e.g., from metrics) will propagate.
risks.trigger: collect_status raises a custom exception from a submodule not in the caught list.

risks.description: _safe_load_project claims to degrade for unknown/malformed config, but load_project may raise OSError (e.g., missing repo_root) which is not caught, violating the documentation guarantee.
risks.location: core.py:_safe_load_project, docstring vs. except ValueError only
risks.trigger: Project exists in listing but its repo_root directory is missing; load_project raises OSError.

todos: Add Claude CLI availability check in routing_summary before recommending claude lane.
Wrap path.stat() in _file_item with try/except OSError and provide defaults.
Broaden exception handling in _safe_collect_status or update docstring.
Catch OSError in _safe_load_project or clarify documentation.

handoff.suggestion: Patch routing_summary to incorporate provider health data; add defensive stat handling in get_queue; review exception coverage in safety wrappers.
